# Boot-identity fact AC-1: discriminator + gatherer + live REM-watchdog classification

AC-1 of neomjs/neo#14490 (the boot-identity health fact, Leaf 1 of neomjs/neo-agent-brain#121) — split out so PR neomjs/neo#14492 truthfully resolves the slice it actually delivers without auto-closing neomjs/neo#14490 while AC-2 is still residual.

## Scope (delivered by PR neomjs/neo#14492)
- The pure `classifyBootFreshness(facts, config)` discriminator + `BOOT_FRESHNESS_CLASS` / `SCHEDULER_RESUME_STATE` codebooks (Neo-free, hermetically unit-testable, advisory-only — never a certainty-class `stale`).
- The `BootIdentityHealthService` advisory scaffold + the live fact-gatherer factory.
- The REM-consolidation liveness watchdog integration: a stall carries its boot-freshness disposition (`restart-explains` / `designed-deferral` / `unknown`), reading a **recognized, recency-bounded** `dream` maintenance-deferral (a generic skip can never mask a genuine stall) without ever suppressing the alarm.
- `HealthService#getTaskOutcome` read-surface (defensive deep clone).

## Out of scope (remains on neomjs/neo#14490)
- **AC-2**: expose the fact on the authenticated control-plane surface (R3-safe — the client Bridge RPC receives the read-only fact, never a restart-affecting command). Gated on the #14501 control-plane substrate decision.
